scope.target: current PBP game_seconds_remaining minus next play_type-nonnull PBP row in the same quarter
scope.holdout_status: NOT HOLDOUT-VALIDATED: weeks 6-9 were already examined in prior E3 work; weeks 1-5 are development comparisons only
scope.folding: leave-one-week-out for all models; week 5 trains only on weeks 1-4

models.A_e1_sampled: E1's empirical clock-runoff donor mechanism; refit to each fold's weeks 1-5 training pool, with the held-out PBP event/cell fixed and 100 deterministic draws from eligible event donors. This is a stochastic baseline, so its MAE is mean per-play expected absolute error over those draws.
models.B_pbp_conditional: Pinned PBP-only hierarchical conditional median model; uses the existing week-held-out predictions.
models.C_tracking_informed: Observed tracking terminal-minus-snap duration plus a same-fold PBP-conditional median residual (PBP delta minus tracking duration). This uses terminal future tracking and is retrospective, not prospective.

limitations: Weeks 6-9 were already examined; none of these weeks 1-5 comparisons are holdout-validated.
A is stochastic and is reported as expected per-play MAE over 100 fixed donor draws; it is not a deterministic point forecast.
C uses terminal tracking duration from the same play, a post-play future label. Its MAE is retrospective decomposition skill and not a pre-snap prediction result.
PBP clock delta is a same-quarter play-row clock difference, not an official whistle timestamp or adjudicated stoppage duration.
PBP-only timeout, out-of-bounds, and penalty clock effects remain unresolvable where the source does not identify them.
